purpose: Freeze the reversible interpretation used to census the already-stored phase2_pubchem_ready.lmdb motif_seq field without claiming that the original producer implementation is known.

producer_provenance.warning: This specification describes stored bytes and audit behavior. It is not evidence that the local current representation.py or build_phase2_ready_lmdb.py produced the ready LMDB.

observed_boundary_evidence.schedule: first and last 256 LMDB keys in byte-lexicographic order

stored_sequence.unit_grammar: outer square-bracket units parsed by square-bracket depth because fragment SMILES may contain nested bracket atoms
stored_sequence.fragment_value: the exact, unnormalized interior of each non-separator outer unit
stored_sequence.top_level_whitespace: accepted and measured but not included in exact fragments

anchor_interpretation.semantics: legacy local attachment labels measured per stored [.] component
anchor_interpretation.p1_pair_rule: measurement only; every label occurs exactly twice per stored component
anchor_interpretation.pair_rule_failure_policy: retain candidate record and report the semantic difference

pure_projection.algorithm: Delete valid anchors only, perform no normalization, and wrap the remaining exact core in one square-bracket pair.
pure_projection.stereochemistry: retained if present in the stored exact fragment

scientific_limits: The bounded observation does not replace a full 301655-record extraction.
This retrospective grammar does not establish producer identity or equivalence to the P1 molecule-native linearizer.
A high exact/pure overlap cannot establish matching stereo, anchor or component semantics.
No P1/P2 vocabulary union, tokenizer freeze or training admission follows from this specification.
